transfer_taxes.source_title: Cuyahoga County Fiscal Officer: Procedures for transferring ownership; ORC 322.02
transfer_taxes.notes: County page states total conveyance fee of $4.00 per $1,000 of purchase price (page also says '.04%', inconsistent; $4/$1,000 = 0.4%). Permissive portion = 0.4% - 0.1% state.
